name: momentum_candidates_v1
status: PRE-REGISTERED before any backtest of these candidates
grids: tycho/momentum.py GRIDS (4 cells per candidate, fixed before results)

costs.funding: real Binance funding, longs pay positive

walk_forward.method: expanding window, annual refit: for test year Y choose the grid cell with the highest Sharpe of daily net returns on all data before Y-01-01; OOS years 2021..2026 (2026 partial)
walk_forward.classification: HISTORICAL WALK-FORWARD DIAGNOSTIC (dev data was used to design earlier experts)

stages.final_params: grid cell with highest Sharpe on the full dev period, fixed before holdouts

holdout_perp.data: every archived Binance USDT-M perpetual (delisted included) outside the dev universe with >=12 monthly files, 2021-01-01 .. 2026-09-30; BTC regime from dev BTC (not traded)
holdout_perp.tradability: point-in-time: 30-day median daily quote volume >= 20M USD and >= 200 bars of history
holdout_perp.classification: UNTOUCHED HOLDOUT (never used before this protocol)

holdout_spot_pre2020.data: Binance spot 4h, BTC ETH BNB XRP ADA LTC LINK TRX DOGE, trading 2018-01-01 .. 2019-12-31 (warmup from 2017-08), no funding
holdout_spot_pre2020.classification: UNTOUCHED HOLDOUT (pre-perpetual era incl. 2018 bear market)

pass_criteria.multiplicity: 5 strategies incl. incumbent; null p threshold 0.01 (evidence.return_diagnostics, 30-day blocks)

engine: selection runs in tycho.engine_multi (Nautilus-parity tested); final numbers re-run in NautilusTrader with fee+slippage in the taker fee and a funding overlay; tycho vs Nautilus final equity must agree within 1% or the result is INVALID
consequence_of_pass: eligible for a NEW frozen prospective paper trial with owner approval; never auto-activated; real money stays disabled
consequence_of_fail: rejected and recorded in research/momentum_trials.jsonl; no re-tuning on holdout data
